scenario.suspicion_context: You were observed attempting to enter the restricted research lab during off-hours, and an unusual item was spotted in your possession, prompting suspicion of unauthorised activities.

clues.name: Standard Indoor Plant
clues.description: A common potted plant used in office settings.
detail_points: Typical office decoration with no unique features
clues.supports: Adds everyday texture without addressing the core suspicion directly.
